title: Code Factory: Proof-by-Sabotage Software Factory
description:
Code Factory is a proof-first, open-source software factory for turning specifications, behavior checks, design contracts, policy verification, Mermaid diagrams, and release receipts into auditable delivery through Unified Graph Ops. Version 0.32 adds Graph Forensics and ProofSearch: sealed semantic lineage identifies the first divergence and deterministic state/concurrency anomalies; ProofSearch binds the resulting proof slice to 2 through 12 supplied repair candidates, rejects failed proofs, surviving mutants, scope escapes, test weakening, and error suppression, then selects the minimum-risk, minimum-scope verified winner. The Graph Ops Counterfactual Arena displays every candidate, exact loss reasons, mutation and proof facts, evidence-bounded savings, and locked apply/merge/release controls. Release media includes the current FactoryLine identity asset and real product captures.

Evidence boundary: ProofSearch does not generate or apply patches, execute candidate commands, mutate tests or checkpoints, approve, merge, publish, deploy, sign, message, access credentials, or grant connectors. Time, token, and cost savings require exact paired observations; productivity remains unavailable without separate measured evidence. A passing receipt proves the declared checks and supplied environment, not arbitrary production security.
